customer_jane: Hey team — noticed a huge jump on last month's bill, invoice for Mar 2026 is ~2.1M tokens higher than what our internal dashboard shows. We're on a private VPC deployment with the onprem metering agent. Can someone triage? 😬

sarah_support: Sorry about that — we’ll dig in. Can you share agent version, agent config, and host clock / NTP status? Also a small sample of audit lines (req ids) and any agent logs around when you saw the spike.

customer_jane: Agent version 1.4.2. Config (redacted):
```json
{
  "buffer_max_events": 100000,
  "replay_policy": "on_reconnect",
  "use_server_timestamps": true
}
```
Host clock is synced via our internal NTP but note we had a maintenance window 2026-03-02 21:40-22:10 UTC where network connectivity to collector was flaky.

mike_infra: Two quick hypotheses: (1) tokenizer mismatch between your agent/tokenizer and Redwood's counting causing a per-request delta; (2) replayed/buffered events were replayed using server timestamps and therefore skipped dedupe, causing double-counting. Do you have a sample audit line and the agent reconnect logs?

tim_onprem: Here's a redacted audit snippet + agent log: 
```text
req_id: abc123
client_ts: 2026-03-02T21:58:02.123Z
server_ingest_ts: 2026-03-02T22:05:10.456Z
tokens_reported_by_agent: 312
tokenizer_hash: tok-v2-rc
```
Agent log around reconnect:
```log
[2026-03-02T22:05:09Z] INFO reconnecting to collector, replaying 116234 events
[2026-03-02T22:05:10Z] WARN replay completed, replay_ts_applied=2026-03-02T22:05:10Z
```
We intentionally set use_server_timestamps=true to try to avoid clock skew problems.

metering-bot: Alert: replayed_events=116234, duplicate_detection_hits=0, server_dedup_window=5m

eng_ml_aly: Note — tokenizer v3 changed some unicode sequence handling and tends to produce ~2-4% more tokens on long chat payloads compared to v2. That alone usually doesn't explain a 10% invoice delta, though.

sarah_support: Putting pieces together: it looks like a two-factor problem. The agent replay overwrote client_ts with server_ingest_ts on replay (use_server_timestamps=true + replay path), which moved events out of the dedupe window, and the tokenizer mismatch increased per-request token counts on server-side re-tokenization. Result = higher token counts + duplicated events.

mike_infra: For repro, tim can you run this tooling to diff tokenizers locally?
```bash
# sample_payloads.json is an array of text inputs captured from your audit dump
python3 tools/token_compare.py --payloads sample_payloads.json --tokenizers tok-v2-rc tok-v3
```
It prints per-request delta and the aggregate token delta.

tim_onprem: Running now... quick results: avg delta +3.8% tokens across sample. Also reconfirming logs, the replay window is ~22:05:09-22:05:12 when network recovered. So ~116k events replayed with server timestamps.

eng_ml_aly: I'll open an internal PR for a tokenizer compatibility shim (v2->v3) for the ingestion pipeline so counts align during rollout. Longer-term we'll version tokenizers in the API schema.

sarah_support: Immediate mitigation plan: (a) patch agent to preserve client_ts on replay (so dedupe can work), (b) backend hotfix to prefer client_ts when present for dedupe, (c) recommend customers set use_server_timestamps=false until agent upgrade. For billing: we need to compute duplicated_tokens = sum(tokens in replay batch) and issue a provisional credit while we verify.

mike_infra: Hotfix agent (1.4.3-alpha) includes timestamp preservation. Workaround for now: set use_server_timestamps=false and restart agent. Example config + restart: 
```yaml
agent:
  use_server_timestamps: false
  buffer_max_events: 200000
```
Restart: `systemctl restart redwood-meter-agent`

tim_onprem: Agent metrics show replay_tokens=1276894 for the replayed batch. Dashboard day_total for 2026-03-02 = 18345123. Invoice link: https://billing.redwood/invoice/INV-2026-03-7890

finance_ryan: cc @sarah_support — I can provision a provisional credit once you confirm duplicated token count. Please include the replay_tokens metric and any per-request deltas if possible.

sarah_support: Thanks — action items: tim to run token_compare and upload replay batch totals; eng_ml_aly will open PR for tokenizer shim; infra to stage 1.4.3-alpha to customers who opt in; finance to provision provisional credit. We'll follow up with a formal credit estimate within 24h. @customer_jane we'll also send step-by-step config commands.

customer_jane: Thanks everyone — we'll set use_server_timestamps=false and run your compare. Appreciate the quick triage.

metering-bot: Note: incident created #INC-2026-0312 by sarah_support

finance_ryan: provisional credit created for INV-2026-03-7890 amount=USD 312.45 (pending final verification) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sarah_support: I'll keep this thread updated with final numbers and the PR links. Closing loop after finance posts final credit.

customer_jane: Got it — standby for upload of token_compare output. Thank you!
